justification: Frontend display-only polish to the Intelligence Brief page: (1) empty states now state the real reason + path (satellite layers -> tick 'Include satellite analysis'; pre-DA -> not in standard brief; overlay -> not mapped for this council; address-not-matched), replacing the dead-end 'Not included'; (2) the SEPP Housing card renders the Low & Mid-Rise standards as a table (form / eligible / min lot / min width / max FSR-height) instead of a 'N · 16 fields' dump; (3) field labels expand acronyms (JRC/WOfS/BoM/FSR/HCA/TOD) and units (M2->m2), and drop internal terms (Postgis); (4) the raw overlay-coverage key dump is hidden and the Data Gaps list shows the contextual detail. No data, query, or regulatory logic changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: Section cards used describeUnavailable(reason) returning a bare {label,tone}; the body showed only the short label ('Not included'). SEPP Housing is a list[SEPPStandard]; the generic SectionData rendered each as 'index · 16 fields'. overlay_coverage (a ~20-key internal list) and the Data Gaps list both printed raw internal strings.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The UI assumed 'Not included' was enough; it dead-ends the user. Verified gating: satellite layers (bushfire/flood/climate/granny_flat/terrain) are blank only because include_satellite was false -> the real path is the checkbox; pre_da_history needs include_premium which this page never sends -> no path here. The SEPP list is the most decision-relevant block and was being dumped.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new dependency. describeUnavailable now takes the section and returns {label, detail, tone} with the verified contextual copy. formatKey expands a small acronym/unit map. A new SeppHousingCard renders the standards table (special-cased like the existing constraint_arithmetic card). overlay_coverage is filtered out; the Data Gaps list reuses describeUnavailable for its detail.
pre_impl.external_source_error: No data or network change. describeUnavailable returns a neutral 'Not included' for any unrecognised reason; SeppHousingCard only renders when the standards list is non-empty, otherwise the generic SectionCard fallback applies; missing numeric standards render as a dash.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Frontend only (TypeScript/React). describeUnavailable returns a typed Unavailable; SeppStandard fields are optional/nullable and guarded before formatting; tsc clean, the only ESLint warning is a pre-existing exhaustive-deps note unrelated to this change.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: 'Not included' with no reason or path; a meaningless SEPP dump; raw internal labels and key lists. After: each blank says why and how to get it (or 'none here'/good news), the SEPP standards read as a real eligibility table, and labels are plain-English.

functions.name: describeUnavailable
functions.input: the internal NOT_AVAILABLE reason string and the brief section key for one empty field or card
functions.output: a plain-language status label, a contextual detail line stating the real reason and path, and a tone
functions.if_none: a null, empty or unrecognised reason returns a neutral 'Not included' so no internal string ever leaks to the user

functions.name: SeppHousingCard
functions.input: the list of Housing-SEPP development standards for the lot, each with eligibility and numeric controls
functions.output: a table of form, eligibility, minimum lot and width and the maximum FSR or height for each permitted form
functions.if_none: the render path only mounts the card when the list is non-empty, otherwise the generic section card is used

values: N/A - no regulatory values are hardcoded. The acronym map is display vocabulary; the SEPP numbers are read from the standards the brief already computed, not invented.
queries: N/A - frontend render change; no database or API query is added. It reads only the already-streamed section data.

break_it.scenario: A satellite layer is blank because the satellite checkbox was not ticked
break_it.what_happens: a bare 'Not included' dead-ends the user with no reason or path to the data
break_it.repro: describeUnavailable('Satellite data not requested', 'satellite.bushfire') returns the 'tick Include satellite analysis and run again' detail
break_it.how: satellite sections map to the real, verified checkbox path; the detail line states exactly how to add the layer

break_it.scenario: Pre-DA history is blank but there is no premium control on this page
break_it.what_happens: telling the user to 'request it' would promise a path that does not exist here
break_it.repro: describeUnavailable('Premium data not requested', 'satellite.pre_da_history') returns 'not part of the standard brief' with no fake path
break_it.how: pre_da_history maps to an honest 'not in this brief' detail rather than an action that the page cannot perform

break_it.scenario: The SEPP Housing standards list is empty or absent for a lot
break_it.what_happens: a table component could render an empty shell or crash on a null list
break_it.repro: the render branch checks standards && standards.length before mounting SeppHousingCard; otherwise the generic SectionCard handles it
break_it.how: SeppHousingCard mounts only for a non-empty list, and each numeric cell falls back to a dash when the standard is null

break_it.scenario: A field label or gap field contains an unknown acronym or an internal term like postgis
break_it.what_happens: the raw internal token would leak into the user-facing label
break_it.repro: formatKey('heritage_postgis') drops 'postgis' and yields 'Heritage'; formatKey('jrc_occurrence_pct') yields 'JRC Occurrence %'
break_it.how: formatKey maps known acronyms/units and maps internal words to an empty string that is filtered out before joining

post_merge.manual_verify: On the Vercel preview, run 25 Empire St (no satellite) and confirm: the Bushfire/Granny-Flat/Terrain/Climate/Flood cards say 'Not run — tick Include satellite analysis and run again'; SEPP Housing renders a form/eligible/min-lot table, not 'N · 16 fields'; field labels read JRC/WOfS/FSR/m² and 'Heritage' (no Postgis); the overlay-coverage key dump is gone; the Data Gaps list reads as contextual states. ANEF live-fallback and the SEPP currency/dedup polish are tracked follow-ups.
